svg.title: Figure 2. A-Islands confirmatory structural benchmark
svg.desc: Frozen design, within-stratum comparison, all 845 estimable species conditional concordance values, four structural quantities with intervals, and explicit fold non-estimability.
svg.text: A-Islands: structure retains incidence information after local support and source distance are frozen
All three structural summaries share the frozen cohort, folds and climate hashes.
Compare structure only after local support and direct source distance are matched.
41 declared taxa had no primary species statistic and remain in Panel E.
Bottleneck evaluation uses -median normalized geographic bottleneck: higher concordance means smaller bottleneck aligns with occupancy.
Applicability is part of the result
Declared: 886 taxa × 5 folds = 4,430 species-fold evaluations. Non-estimable rows are not dropped.
The primary 845-species distribution and 793-species bottleneck summary therefore have different applicability; neither denominator is hidden.
